caseTitle.zh: 接種後事件與發燒的疹子
caseTitle.en: Events after a jab, and a feverish rash

condition.zh: 疫苗安全 · 接種後事件

title.en: A public-health night in the emergency department

tagline.zh: 訊號是問題，不是答案；疹子加發燒，先想麻疹
tagline.en: A signal is a question, not an answer; rash plus fever, think measles first

desc.zh: 跟著魏醫師找分母、分辨昏倒與過敏、接校護與疾管的電話、面對在錄影的媽媽。
desc.en: Find the denominator with Dr Wei, tell a faint from anaphylaxis, take the school nurse's and the CDC's calls, and face a mother who is filming.

desc.zh: 批號與冷鏈紀錄、負壓隔離室、防護裝備穿脫、接觸者名單都在你手上。
desc.en: Lot numbers and cold-chain logs, the negative-pressure room, donning and doffing, and the contact list are yours.

about.zh: 手機裡有每一批疫苗的批號照片。口頭禪：訊號是問題，不是答案。
about.en: Has a photo of every vaccine lot number on his phone. Catchphrase: a signal is a question, not an answer.

about.zh: 可以同時處理三個昏倒的學生和一個發燒的疹子。唯一怕的是記者。
about.en: Can handle three fainting students and one feverish rash at once. The only thing he fears is a reporter.

about.zh: 負壓隔離室的鑰匙掛在脖子上。脫防護裝備的順序她可以倒著背。
about.en: Wears the negative-pressure room key round her neck. Can recite the doffing sequence backwards.

role.zh: 十六歲，接種後昏倒的學生

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。打針前沒吃午餐，看到前排同學倒下，自己也倒了。醒來第一句：影片不要傳。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Skipped lunch before the jab, saw the boy in front go down, went down himself. First words on waking: don't share the video.

about.zh: 到急診時手機已經在錄影。要一個「停止全校接種」的答案。
about.en: Was already filming when she reached the emergency department. Wants the answer “stop the whole school's vaccination”.

role.zh: 二十四歲，發燒出疹的旅客
role.en: Twenty-four; traveller with fever and rash

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。上週出國回來，發燒三天，今天從耳後開始出疹。小時候的接種紀錄找不到。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Back from abroad last week, three days of fever, and today a rash starting behind the ears. Childhood vaccination record nowhere to be found.

about.zh: 體育館裡還有兩百位學生排隊，又有五位說頭暈。
about.en: Two hundred students still queuing in the gym, and five more say they feel dizzy.

role.zh: 疾病管制值班人員（電話）

about.zh: 二十四小時接通報。要病例定義、批號、接觸者名單，一樣都不能少。
about.en: Takes notifications round the clock. Wants the case definition, the lot number and the contact list, every one of them.

plain.zh: 打完疫苗之後發生的任何不舒服，不管是不是疫苗造成的。先通報，再判斷因果。
plain.en: Anything unpleasant that happens after a vaccine, whether or not the vaccine caused it. Report first, judge causality after.

plain.zh: 一群事件看起來比平常多，值得去查。它是問題，不是答案。
plain.en: A cluster of events that looks bigger than usual and deserves a look. It is a question, not an answer.

plain.zh: 就算沒有打疫苗，同樣的人在同樣的時間裡本來就會發生多少事。比較之前先知道它。
plain.en: How often the same thing would happen to the same people in the same time with no vaccine at all. Know it before you compare.

plain.zh: 由專家依時間、機轉、其他原因與過去資料判斷事件和疫苗有沒有關係。不是急診當晚做的事。
plain.en: Experts weighing timing, mechanism, other causes and past data to decide whether the vaccine was responsible. Not something done in the emergency department that night.

plain.zh: 緊張、疼痛、空腹、久站觸發神經反射，心跳變慢、血壓下降而昏倒。躺平就恢復，沒有疹子也不會喘。
plain.en: Stress, pain, an empty stomach or standing trigger a nerve reflex: the heart slows, the pressure drops, the person faints. Lying flat restores it; no rash, no wheeze.

plain.zh: 快速、全身性的嚴重過敏：蕁麻疹或腫、喘或喉嚨緊、血壓下降而心跳快。要立刻依流程處置。
plain.en: A rapid, whole-body severe allergy: hives or swelling, wheeze or a tight throat, a falling pressure with a fast heart. Treated at once per protocol.

plain.zh: 看到別人倒下，自己也頭暈、過度換氣或倒下，像漣漪一樣傳開。常見於學校集體接種。
plain.en: Seeing someone else go down, others feel faint, overbreathe or collapse, spreading like ripples. Common at school vaccination sessions.

plain.zh: 同一次製造的疫苗的編號。事件發生時，批號告訴你範圍，也告訴你該保全哪些瓶。
plain.en: The number of one manufacturing batch of vaccine. When something happens, the lot number sets the scope and tells you which vials to secure.

plain.zh: 疫苗從工廠到針筒全程維持在規定溫度的紀錄。斷了鏈，疫苗可能失效。
plain.en: The record that a vaccine stayed at the required temperature from factory to syringe. A broken chain can mean a spoiled vaccine.

plain.zh: 傳染力極強的病毒：發燒、咳嗽、結膜炎、口腔黏膜白點，再從頭往下出疹。出疹前後各幾天都會傳染。
plain.en: A highly contagious virus: fever, cough, conjunctivitis, white spots inside the mouth, then a rash spreading from the head downwards. Infectious for days before and after the rash.

plain.zh: 病原隨著懸浮的細小飛沫在空氣中飄，離開房間後還能傳染。所以要負壓與高防護口罩。
plain.en: Germs riding tiny suspended droplets that drift through the air and remain infectious after the person has left the room. Hence negative pressure and a high-filtration respirator.

plain.zh: 室內氣壓低於外面，空氣只進不出，再經過濾排放。空氣傳播的病人要住這裡。
plain.en: A room kept at lower pressure than outside so air flows in but not out, then leaves through a filter. Where an airborne case belongs.

plain.zh: 列出可傳染期內與病人共處過的每一個人，評估免疫狀態，安排預防與追蹤。
plain.en: Listing everyone who shared air with the case during the infectious period, assessing their immunity, arranging prophylaxis and follow-up.

plain.zh: 接觸之後、發病之前趕快做的預防：對麻疹是在時限內補接種或給免疫球蛋白。時限一過就沒有了。
plain.en: Prevention given after exposure and before illness: for measles, a vaccine or immunoglobulin within a time window. Miss the window and the chance is gone.

plain.zh: 依法在規定時限內通知主管機關。麻疹要在二十四小時內通報，不等檢驗結果。
plain.en: Reporting to the health authority within the legal time limit. Measles is notified within twenty-four hours, without waiting for the laboratory.

plain.zh: 說已知、說未知、說正在做什麼、說下次更新時間。面對一支正在錄影的手機也一樣。
plain.en: Say what is known, what is unknown, what is being done and when the next update comes. Even to a phone that is recording.

text.zh: 過敏性休克的處置都在最上層抽屜。每一場集體接種現場也有一台縮小版，離針筒不超過幾步。
text.en: Everything for anaphylaxis lives in the top drawer. Every mass vaccination session has a small version too, never more than a few steps from the syringes.

text.zh: 前室、壓差表、門不能同時開。進去戴高防護口罩，出來在前室脫。
text.en: Anteroom, pressure gauge, never both doors at once. Respirator on before entering; everything comes off in the anteroom.

text.zh: 今晚多了一欄：校園接種、昏倒三位、頭暈五位、分母待查。再多一欄：疑似麻疹，一位。
text.en: Tonight it has an extra column: school vaccination, three faints, five dizzy, denominator pending. And another: suspected measles, one.

text.zh: 鏡子、垃圾桶、乾洗手液、牆上的順序圖。脫錯一步，前面做的都白費。
text.en: A mirror, a bin, hand rub, the sequence poster on the wall. One step wrong on the way out undoes everything before it.

text.zh: 校護傳真來的。三個倒下的學生圈在同一排，相隔兩個座位；五個頭暈的在他們後面。漣漪的形狀。
text.en: Faxed by the school nurse. The three who fainted are circled in the same row, two seats apart; the five dizzy ones sit behind them. The shape of a ripple.

name.zh: 訊號不等於因果：觀察值與期望值
name.en: A signal is not causation: observed versus expected

text.zh: 三位昏倒看起來很多。問：今天打了幾位？青少年集體接種的背景發生率多少？事件是不是集中在同一排、同一時刻、看見彼此的人？觀察值高於期望值才叫訊號；訊號之後是調查，不是結論。
text.en: Three faints look like a lot. Ask: how many were vaccinated today? What is the background rate at adolescent mass sessions? Did the events cluster in one row, one moment, among people who could see each other? Only observed above expected is a signal, and a signal is followed by an investigation, not a conclusion.

text.zh: 血管迷走反應：臉白、冒汗、心跳慢、躺平就回來，沒有疹子、不喘。過敏性休克：皮膚或黏膜腫、蕁麻疹、喘或喉嚨緊、血壓低而心跳快，發展很快。分不清時，看皮膚、聽呼吸、量兩次血壓；懷疑過敏就依流程處置，不要等。
text.en: Vasovagal: pale, sweaty, slow pulse, recovers lying flat, no rash, no wheeze. Anaphylaxis: swelling of skin or mucosa, hives, wheeze or tight throat, low pressure with a fast pulse, evolving quickly. When unsure, look at the skin, listen to the breathing, take the pressure twice; if anaphylaxis is suspected, treat per protocol and do not wait.

name.zh: 麻疹為什麼是公共衛生的急診
name.en: Why measles is a public-health emergency

text.zh: 空氣傳播、傳染力極強，出疹前幾天就會傳染，病人離開後空氣裡還有病毒。所以：疑似就隔離，不等檢驗；二十四小時內通報；列出候診區、同班機、同住的所有接觸者；暴露後預防有時限，過了就沒有。一個病例，就是一次疫調。
text.en: Airborne and extremely contagious, infectious days before the rash, with virus lingering in the air after the patient leaves. So: isolate on suspicion without waiting for the lab; notify within twenty-four hours; list every contact in the waiting area, on the flight and at home; post-exposure prophylaxis has a window that closes. One case is one outbreak investigation.

text.zh: 暫停聽起來最安全，其實有價。接種率掉下來，疾病就回來；信任掉下來，更難回來。保全批號、改躺姿、吃早餐、延長觀察、公開說明，然後繼續。真的有安全訊號時再停，而且要說清楚為什麼停、什麼時候恢復。
text.en: Pausing sounds safest, but it has a price. Coverage falls and the disease returns; trust falls and is harder to recover. Secure the lot, vaccinate lying down, insist on breakfast, extend observation, explain publicly, and continue. Pause when there is a real safety signal, and say clearly why you paused and when you will resume.

note.zh: 三位昏倒；先把分母找回來

guide.en: Find Dr Wei at the ED board

sub.zh: 三位學生接種後昏倒，救護車已送急診
sub.en: Three students fainted after the jab; ambulance en route

lines.zh: 三位學生打完針昏倒，救護車送過去了。體育館還有兩百位排隊，又有五位說頭暈。家長群組已經在傳影片。
lines.en: Three students fainted after the jab; the ambulance is on its way to you. Two hundred still queuing, five more say they feel dizzy, and the parents' group chat already has a video.

lines.zh: 訊號是問題，不是答案。病人先。然後第二個問題是什麼？
lines.en: A signal is a question, not an answer. Patients first. Then what is the second question?

lines.zh: 分母。今天到現在打了幾位？
lines.en: The denominator. How many have been vaccinated so far today?

lines.zh: 三百多位。
lines.en: Three hundred and something.

post.zh: 三位除以三百多位。再問：青少年集體接種的背景發生率是多少？不知道的話，先別說「很多」。
post.en: Three out of three hundred and something. Next: what is the background rate at adolescent mass sessions? Until you know, do not say “a lot”.

guide.zh: 找出今天的批號與冷鏈
guide.en: Find today's lot and cold-chain log

lines.zh: 第三個問題：疫苗批號、冷鏈紀錄、剩餘的瓶子。先找到，先保全，不下結論。
lines.en: Third question: lot number, cold-chain log, the remaining vials. Find them, secure them, conclude nothing.

q.zh: 找到今天接種的批號與冷鏈紀錄
q.en: Find today's vaccine lot number and cold-chain record

post.zh: 批號拍下來了，冷鏈紀錄全程在範圍內。剩餘的瓶子我請校護鎖進冰箱，先不丟、先不用。
post.en: Lot photographed, cold chain in range throughout. I've asked the school nurse to lock the remaining vials in the fridge: not discarded, not used.

note.zh: 昏倒還是過敏；同一排的漣漪
note.en: A faint or anaphylaxis; a ripple along one row

lines.zh: 小宇躺在推床上，臉色白，額頭有汗。監視器上心跳慢。
lines.en: Hsiao-Yu lies on the trolley, pale, forehead damp. The monitor shows a slow heart rate.

lines.zh: 我沒吃午餐……看到前面的同學倒，我就……影片不要傳……
lines.en: I skipped lunch… I saw the boy in front go down and then I… don't share the video…

lines.zh: 公衛的，你先評估。昏倒還是過敏？
lines.en: Public health, your assessment first. A faint, or anaphylaxis?

options.zh: 平躺抬腿、監測、看皮膚聽呼吸、觀察
options.en: Flat, legs up, monitor, check skin and breathing, observe

why.zh: 心跳慢、臉白、冒汗、沒有疹子不喘：血管迷走反應。但每一次都要親眼排除過敏。
why.en: Slow pulse, pale, sweaty, no rash, no wheeze: a vasovagal reaction. But anaphylaxis is ruled out by looking, every single time.

options.zh: 立刻依過敏性休克處置

why.zh: 過敏性休克是心跳快、血壓低、皮膚或呼吸道有變化。他是心跳慢，沒有疹子也不喘。看了才處置，不是猜。
why.en: Anaphylaxis brings a fast pulse, low pressure and skin or airway changes. He has a slow pulse, no rash, no wheeze. Treat what you see, not what you fear.

options.en: Sit him up and give him water

why.zh: 坐起來會再倒，這次會撞到推床。
why.en: Sitting up, he goes down again, into the trolley this time.

post.zh: 躺平後心跳回來、血壓回來，皮膚乾淨，呼吸順。血管迷走反應。
post.en: Flat, the pulse and pressure come back, skin clear, breathing easy. Vasovagal.
All three the same? Same row?

post.zh: 都是。校護說三個坐同一排，相隔兩個位子。
post.en: All three. The school nurse says they sat in the same row, two seats apart.

guide.zh: 和魏醫師談這是不是訊號
guide.en: Discuss with Dr Wei whether this is a signal

lines.zh: 三個血管迷走反應、同一排、幾分鐘內、看得見彼此。這是疫苗的訊號，還是別的？
lines.en: Three vasovagal reactions, one row, within minutes, in sight of each other. A vaccine signal, or something else?

lines.zh: 像群聚心因性反應加空腹。但「像」不夠，要先把問題定義清楚。
lines.en: It looks like a mass psychogenic response plus empty stomachs. But “looks like” is not enough; define the question first.

post.zh: 問題定義好了：接種後數分鐘內的昏倒，同一場次。事件通報照做，因果評估交給專家。我們今晚只做觀察與保全。
post.en: The question is defined: faints within minutes of vaccination at one session. The event reports go in; causality assessment goes to the experts. Tonight we observe and secure.

note.zh: 風險溝通；通報流程；保全批號
note.en: Risk communication; the report; secure the lot

lines.zh: 三個小孩倒了，你們還要繼續打？這疫苗有問題！我在錄影，你說。
lines.en: Three children collapsed and you're still going? There's something wrong with this vaccine! I'm recording. Speak.

q.zh: 媽媽邊錄影邊要求停止全校接種。你怎麼回？
q.en: The mother, filming, demands the whole school's vaccination be stopped. What do you say?

options.zh: 說已知未知、改躺姿延長觀察、保全批號、不中斷
options.en: State known and unknown; vaccinate lying down, observe longer, secure the lot, continue

why.zh: 透明、有具體作為、有下次更新時間。暫停有代價，要有真的安全訊號才停。
why.en: Transparent, with concrete actions and a time for the next update. Pausing has a price; it takes a real safety signal.

options.zh: 立刻宣布全校暫停接種

why.zh: 沒有訊號就暫停，接種率和信任一起掉，而且很難說清楚什麼時候恢復。
why.en: Pausing without a signal drops coverage and trust together, and nobody can say when it resumes.

options.en: Ask her to delete the video first

why.zh: 問題不是影片，是答案。她刪了，別人還有。
why.en: The problem is not the video; it is the answer. She deletes it, someone else still has one.

post.zh: ……所以他是餓到昏倒，不是疫苗？
post.en: …So he fainted from hunger, not from the vaccine?

post.zh: 目前看起來是空腹加緊張的反應。但「目前看起來」會寫進通報，由專家評估，我們下午五點再更新一次。
post.en: Right now it looks like a reaction to an empty stomach and nerves. But “right now it looks like” goes into the report for the experts, and we update again at five.
Mum, I really didn't eat lunch.

guide.zh: 排出接種後事件通報流程

lines.zh: 接種後不良事件的通報，順序你排。先處置，後通報，因果最後。
lines.en: The adverse event following immunisation report. Your order: treat first, report next, causality last.

q.zh: 接種後不良事件的處理與通報
q.en: Handling and reporting an adverse event following immunisation

steps.en: Treat and stabilise the patient first

steps.zh: 記錄疫苗、批號、接種與發作時間
steps.en: Record vaccine, lot, times of jab and onset
Report to the adverse event system

steps.zh: 保全剩餘疫苗與冷鏈紀錄
steps.en: Secure remaining vials and cold-chain log
Causality assessment to the expert panel
Feed back to parents and school

post.zh: 最後一步不是多餘的。沒有回覆，下一次沒有人來。
post.en: The last step is not optional. Without feedback, nobody comes next time.

lines.zh: 保全紀錄：批號、剩餘瓶數、冰箱溫度、上鎖時間、誰鎖的。照片附上。
lines.en: Securing record: lot, vials remaining, fridge temperature, time locked, who locked it. Photos attached.

lines.zh: 專家如果要看，這一批的每一瓶都找得到。
lines.en: If the panel wants to look, every vial of this lot can be found.

note.zh: 三除以三百；一張座位圖
note.en: Three over three hundred; a seating map

guide.en: Do the numbers at the station

lines.zh: 三位昏倒除以三百多位接種。青少年集體接種的背景發生率，比這個高還是低？
lines.en: Three faints over three hundred and something vaccinated. Is the background rate at adolescent mass sessions higher or lower than that?

lines.zh: 文獻裡的範圍差不多，甚至更高。觀察值沒有明顯高於期望值。
lines.en: The literature range is similar, if anything higher. Observed is not clearly above expected.

post.zh: 所以這不是疫苗的安全訊號，是一場集體接種的正常風險加一點漣漪。寫下來，連同限制。
post.en: So it is not a vaccine safety signal; it is the ordinary risk of a mass session plus a ripple. Write it down, with its limitations.

post.zh: 校護傳真來了：座位圖。三個圈在同一排，五個頭暈的在後面。
post.en: The school nurse faxed the seating map. Three circles in one row, the five dizzy ones behind them.

lines.zh: 三位都吃了東西、走得穩，依流程觀察後出院。我請他們明天早餐要吃。
lines.en: All three have eaten, walk steadily, observed per protocol and discharged. I told them to eat breakfast tomorrow.

lines.zh: 五點的更新：體育館改躺姿接種、吃過東西才打、延長觀察。沒有再倒。
lines.en: Five o'clock update: the gym switched to vaccinating lying down, nobody vaccinated on an empty stomach, longer observation. No more faints.

lines.zh: 太好了。那我可以去看那個疹子了。
lines.en: Good. Then I can go and look at that rash.

sub.zh: 18:00 · 急診白板與影像工作站

note.en: Rash plus fever: think measles first

guide.en: Look at the rash on the workstation

lines.zh: 二十四歲，上週出國回來，發燒三天、咳嗽、眼睛紅，今天從耳後開始出疹往下長。在候診區坐了一小時。
lines.en: Twenty-four, back from abroad last week, three days of fever, cough, red eyes, and today a rash starting behind the ears and spreading down. Sat in the waiting area for an hour.

lines.zh: 疹子加發燒加咳嗽加結膜炎，從頭往下。你先想到什麼？
lines.en: Rash, fever, cough, conjunctivitis, spreading from the head down. What comes to mind first?

lines.zh: 麻疹。先隔離，再想別的。
lines.en: Measles. Isolate first, think later.

question.zh: 接種部位的紅腫疹子，和麻疹的疹子，哪些特徵要分開？
question.en: How do you tell a local reaction at the injection site from a measles rash?

answer.zh: 接種部位的局部紅、腫、痛是常見反應，一兩天內消。麻疹是全身性紅疹，先有發燒、咳嗽、流鼻水、結膜炎與口腔黏膜白點，疹子從耳後與髮際開始往下蔓延。全身疹加發燒，就是隔離與通報的理由。
answer.en: Local redness, swelling and soreness at the injection site are common and fade within a day or two. Measles is a generalised red rash preceded by fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis and white spots inside the mouth, starting behind the ears and at the hairline and spreading downwards. A generalised rash with fever is a reason to isolate and notify.

post.zh: 今天打的疫苗不會在今天讓人出這種疹子。這兩件事要分開，不然晚上的新聞會把它們接在一起。
post.en: Today's vaccine does not produce this rash today. Keep the two apart, or tonight's news will join them for you.

lines.zh: 負壓隔離室開了，壓差正常。進去之前，疑似麻疹的處置順序，你排。
lines.en: Negative-pressure room is up, pressure differential normal. Before we go in, the sequence for suspected measles. Your order.

q.zh: 疑似麻疹病例的處置順序

steps.zh: 立即負壓隔離，戴高防護口罩
二十四小時內法定傳染病通報
steps.en: Notify as a notifiable disease within a day
Collect specimens; do not wait for results

steps.zh: 列出可傳染期的所有接觸者
steps.en: List every contact in the infectious period

steps.zh: 評估免疫狀態，安排暴露後預防
追蹤接觸者至潛伏期結束
steps.en: Follow contacts to the end of incubation

post.zh: 候診區那一小時的每一個人，都在名單上。包括掛號櫃台。
post.en: Everyone in the waiting area during that hour is on the list. Including the registration desk.

guide.en: Interview Hsien in the isolation room

lines.zh: 我只是感冒加過敏吧？出國前都好好的。小時候有沒有打疫苗我不知道，我媽也不記得。
lines.en: It's just a cold and an allergy, isn't it? I was fine before the trip. Whether I had my childhood jabs, I don't know; my mum doesn't remember either.

lines.zh: 發燒哪天開始？哪天回國？搭哪一班？回來以後去過哪裡、和誰同住？
lines.en: Which day did the fever start? Which day did you fly back, which flight? Where have you been since, and who do you live with?

lines.zh: ……我室友懷孕了。
lines.en: …My flatmate is pregnant.

lines.zh: 這一句話，把今晚變成一場疫調。孕婦、嬰兒、免疫低下的接觸者，暴露後預防的時限今晚就在跑。
lines.en: That sentence turns tonight into an outbreak investigation. A pregnant contact, infants, anyone immunocompromised: the post-exposure prophylaxis clock is already running.

lines.zh: 出來了。脫的順序比穿重要。鏡子在那邊，每脫一件乾洗手一次。
lines.en: You're out. The order coming off matters more than going on. Mirror's there; hand rub after every item.

post.zh: 口罩最後脫，在前室外面。空氣傳播的病人，口罩是最後一道。
post.en: Respirator last, outside the anteroom. With an airborne case, the respirator is the final line.

guide.en: Take the CDC call at the station

sub.zh: 收到疑似麻疹通報，要接觸者名單
sub.en: Suspected measles notification received; contact list needed

lines.zh: 收到疑似麻疹通報。病例定義、發病日、航班、同住者、急診候診區名單，今晚要。孕婦接觸者優先。
lines.en: Suspected measles notification received. Case definition, onset date, flight, household, waiting-area list: tonight. Pregnant contacts first.

lines.zh: 候診區名單急診已調出，掛號系統有時間戳。室友懷孕，已通知產科評估暴露後預防。航班名單請你們協助。
lines.en: The waiting-area list is pulled from registration time stamps. The pregnant flatmate is referred to obstetrics for post-exposure prophylaxis. We need your help with the flight manifest.

lines.zh: 航班我們來。檢體明早到實驗室，結果出來前依疑似處理。
lines.en: The flight is ours. Specimens reach the lab in the morning; until then, manage as suspected.

lines.zh: 接觸者追蹤的名單要去重複、要有聯絡方式、要分免疫狀態。做到半夜也要做完第一輪。
lines.en: The contact tracing list gets de-duplicated, with a phone number and an immunity status for each. First round done tonight, however late.

lines.zh: 今天三件事：訊號是問題不是答案；昏倒和過敏用眼睛分；疹子加發燒先想麻疹。
lines.en: Three things today: a signal is a question, not an answer; a faint and anaphylaxis are told apart by looking; rash plus fever, think measles first.

lines.zh: 手機亮了一下。
lines.en: Your phone lights up.

sub.zh: 明天接種照常，家長群組安靜了
sub.en: Tomorrow's session goes ahead; the parents' chat has gone quiet

lines.zh: 明天照常。躺著打、吃過早餐才打、觀察半小時。小宇媽媽在群組貼了你五點的更新，說「他們有講清楚」。
lines.en: Tomorrow goes ahead: lying down, breakfast first, half an hour's observation. Hsiao-Yu's mother posted your five o'clock update in the group and wrote “they explained it properly”.

lines.zh: 沒有發生的事，就是最好的成績。
lines.en: The thing that did not happen is the best result.

sub.zh: 家長群組炸了，一半的人要退出接種
sub.en: The parents' chat has exploded; half want to pull out

lines.zh: 影片上了晚間新聞，標題是「衛生單位緊急暫停」。家長群組一半的人說不打了。明天怎麼辦？
lines.en: The video made the evening news under “health authority emergency halt”. Half the parents say they are pulling out. What do we do tomorrow?

lines.zh: 明早八點我到學校，站在體育館門口說清楚：為什麼停、看到什麼、什麼時候恢復。這是我今天下午該講清楚的。
lines.en: I will be at the school at eight, at the gym door, to say it plainly: why we paused, what we found, when we resume. That was mine to say properly this afternoon.

lines.zh: 白板上兩欄都寫滿了。負壓隔離室的壓差表指針穩穩地停在負的那一邊。
lines.en: Both columns on the board are full. On the isolation room gauge, the needle rests steadily on the negative side.

sub.en: A signal is a question, not an answer
